{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-check the data to confirm the sex column
print("Unique values in 'sex':")
print(df['sex'].unique())

# Check response variable
print("\nUnique values in 'responded':")
print(df['responded'].unique())

# Check for missing values in sex and responded
print("\nMissing values in 'sex' and 'responded':")
print(df[['sex', 'responded']].isnull().sum())

# Check the distribution of sex
print("\nDistribution of sex:")
print(df['sex'].value_counts())

# Check the response rate by sex
response_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rate by sex:")
print(response_by_sex)

# Calculate raw difference in response rates
raw_diff = response_by_sex['F'] - response_by_sex['M']
print(f"\nRaw difference in response rate (F - M): {raw_diff * 100:.2f}%")"}
